requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The printer must support new NGB keyed bottles with a minimum 6,000-page yield for black and 6,000-page yield for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: High-yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement, enhance user convenience, and lower total cost of ownership, supporting competitive differentiation in SMB and Enterprise markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with CISS, IDS, and NOA-F; compatible with Magi/Nessie ink; factory line modifications required.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System accepts and recognizes new NGB keyed bottles; Black yields at least 6,000 pages, CMY yields at least 6,000 pages, CMY bottle supports >8,000 pages; verified through yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The ink bottle and tank system must ensure spill-free reliability during bottle installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents mess, improves customer experience, and reduces service incidents related to ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design, NOA-F integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills occur during normal bottle installation/replacement in lab and field test scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: The NOA-F (Non-Ozone Air Filter) must include a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, with no changes to click on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and compliance with air filtration requirements while maintaining compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F component sourcing and design, push-push and TDF compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units have metal foiled labyrinth and lid label; click on push-push and TDF mechanisms function as in previous models.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: The printer must allow end customers to replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components easily.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers support costs by enabling user-replaceable key components.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design for tool-less or simple replacement; documentation and packaging updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F without special tools, as verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must achieve a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 printed pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher duty cycles for SMB/Enterprise customers and aligns with market expectations for reliability and longevity.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability (PHA, paperpath, tubes, etc.), consumables life, firmware monitoring.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably for 80,000 pages under warranty conditions; verified by accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray and Tank Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Input and output trays must be modified to align with the increased tank protrusion, and overall size optimization must be achieved.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates larger ink tanks without compromising paper handling or increasing overall device footprint unnecessarily.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, mechanical layout, packaging requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function with new tank size; device passes size and fit validation; no paper handling issues observed.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: The product must include a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) for enhanced user interaction.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience through better navigation, status reporting, and feature access.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware support, mechanical integration, supply chain for display components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional in prototype and production units; user feedback meets satisfaction criteria.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: The printer must leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, with new routing and integration for four tubes.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow, reliability, and compatibility with CISS and new bottle sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube sourcing, integration with IDS and ink tanks, mechanical design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube system passes flow rate, reliability, and serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Service station must include aerosol management features, with changes to accommodate the new tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol contamination inside the device, ensuring reliability and safety.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, integration with tank and carriage systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment verified in environmental and reliability testing; no ink aerosol detected outside containment area.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamics and force model to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality, mechanical reliability, and longevity with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube and tank design, carriage design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force tolerances; no print artifacts or mechanical failures observed in testing.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Upgrade for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: The printer paperpath must be upgraded to support increased page life, aligning with the 80,000-page warranty goal.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents paper jams and wear over extended duty cycles, critical for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Material selection, mechanical redesign, reliability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath supports 80,000 pages with no more than X% jam rate (to be defined by quality standards).

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Ink maintenance components must be designed as serviceable parts, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends overall device life and reduces total cost of ownership for high-usage customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Component modularity, service documentation, supply chain for replacement parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service center can replace ink maintenance components in under Y minutes (TBD); component passes post-replacement validation.

requirements.Title: IDS with New Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection for the Integrated Delivery System (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures secure, reliable ink delivery with larger tanks and keyed access, preventing misinstallation.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS redesign, compatibility with new bottles and tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes fluidic connection integrity tests and keying validation; no misinstallation observed in usability studies.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop and implement a new startup algorithm for the IDS with advanced air management to optimize ink flow and print quality.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces startup issues, air entrapment, and print quality defects, especially with larger tanks and longer tube runs.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware development, IDS hardware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm enables consistent ink flow and print quality in lab and field tests; air management validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion metrics to align with the defined page yield and warranty life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer satisfaction and compliance with page yield claims and warranty commitments.
requirements.Dependencies: Print quality test protocols, firmware monitoring, consumables tracking.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets or exceeds new PQ goals over the stated page yield; depletion metrics align with warranty and marketing claims.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: The printer must reuse the Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for cost and supply chain efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development costs, leverages proven components, and streamlines manufacturing.
requirements.Dependencies: Component compatibility with new hardware and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as expected in the new design; no integration issues found in system testing.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern wireless printing standards and enhances device connectivity for SMB/Enterprise environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, hardware integration, regulatory compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity, range, and security tests; certified for target markets.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW) Implementation
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features to protect device, data, and network integrity.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses increasing security requirements in SMB and Enterprise environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware development, regulatory review.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes HP and industry security certification; no critical vulnerabilities found in penetration testing.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency standards for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and competitive positioning, especially in government and large enterprise sectors.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, material selection, documentation, certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for packaging to protect the product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product arrives undamaged, reducing returns and improving customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design, supply chain sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes drop and vibration tests in EPS foam packaging; no damage observed.

requirements.Title: Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Business Models
requirements.Description: The printer must support business models for consumers, SMB, and enterprise customers, including services such as PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via multiple HP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible go-to-market strategies and broadens addressable market segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, drivers, onboarding flows, portal integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business model features available in firmware and onboarding flows; validated in market pilots.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Include a scan solution and SMB manageability features, with enterprise support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB and enterprise workflow needs and IT management requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, software, driver integration, support for WJA/HPSM/JAM.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and manageability features functional in test and pilot deployments; integration with WJA, HPSM, JAM verified.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: The product must support a broad range of client and driver software, including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with diverse IT environments and enhances user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, driver development, QA testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers are available, installable, and functional on supported platforms.

requirements.Title: 25/20 ppm Print Speed (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: The printer must achieve print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 20 ppm for color, with PDL speeds at 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and user productivity needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine design, firmware tuning, consumables performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves at least 25/20 ppm (25/19 ppm PDL) in standard benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: The SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) must achieve a life of at least 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high duty cycles and reduces service frequency for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA design, consumables compatibility, firmware monitoring.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA operates reliably for at least 65,000 pages in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The product warranty must cover 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with industry standards and customer expectations for reliability and support.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, service model, legal review.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and honored; verified through warranty tracking and customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Serviceability via Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: The printer must include a serviceable maintenance box to facilitate easy servicing and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Improves service efficiency and reduces device downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service documentation, supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in under Z minutes (TBD) by service personnel; passes serviceability testing.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Support (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Support for 12,000-page CMYK host and 6,000-page trade page configurations as flexible options.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for product line extension and customization for different market needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, consumables configuration, SKU management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product can be configured for 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page options; validated in configuration testing.
